Lena (Auditor): Hi all — prepping SOC2 evidence collection. We need: RBAC change audit (pre/post snapshots), KMS rotation proof with policy hash, vuln triage -> incident linkage, and a signed export bundle with verification steps. Please map artifacts to control IDs and include UTC timestamps.

Sanjay (eng-security): Quick clarifying Qs: 1) Sampling strategy — random vs targeted on high-privilege roles? 2) Retention window (90d / 1y / 3y)?

Priya (sec-eng): We recommend targeted sample for high-privilege roles + any service-account changes. Deliverables we can produce: 
- rbac/snapshots/<id>-pre.csv and <id>-post.csv (role,principal,type)
- iam/policy_versions/<role>-history.csv (version,author,ts,commit_sha)
- kms/rotation.csv (key_id,rotation_ts,version,policy_sha256)
- vuln/triage_map.csv (vuln_id,discover_ts,owner,fix_pr,deploy_ts,incident_id)
- sa/deprov.csv (sa_email,actor,ts,pr_link,pipeline_run)
All files RFC3339 UTC. We'll GPG-sign the manifest and provide sha256 sums.

Lena (Auditor): Targeted sample is fine. Retention: 1 year preferred. Must include manifest.json (signed), sha256 list, and mapping file control_map.csv (artifact -> control id). For KMS, include envelope metadata: key_id, rotation_version, policy_sha256.

Noah (infra): I'll start an export job and attach an oncall run for traceability. @audit-bot start export --bundle=soc2-2026-targeted --include=rba,kms,iam,vulns,sa

audit-bot: Export queued: id=exp-2026-06-01-300 start=2026-06-01T14:05:22Z target=s3://redwood-audit-exports/soc2/exp-300. Progress will be posted.

Priya (sec-eng): A couple of implementation notes: 
- RBAC snapshots will include both kube RBAC rolebindings and cloud IAM role-to-principal dumps for sampled roles.
- For pre-change snapshots we capture state within 5 minutes before the change event (per audit log) when available; post-change will be within 5 minutes after completion.
- We'll include PR/commit SHA and CI run URL for any change.

Sanjay (eng-security): For vuln triage -> incident linkage we will output a compact timeline per vuln that auditors can quickly scan: {vuln_id,cvss,discover_ts,triage_owner,fix_pr,deploy_ts,incident_id|null}. We'll also include any retrospective incident playbook links.

Lena (Auditor): Good. Also include proof of deprovisioning for SAs that had elevated perms: PR link + pipeline log that ran the revoke.

Priya (sec-eng): We'll include SA_DEPROV rows with a short snippet of pipeline log (redacted) and link to full run.

audit-bot: Update exp-2026-06-01-300: bundle created soc2-targeted-bundle.tar.gz uploaded to s3://redwood-audit-exports/soc2/exp-300/soc2-targeted-bundle.tar.gz. Signed manifest: soc2-targeted-bundle.manifest.sig

Noah (infra): Presigned link (7d): https://s3-presigned.redwood.example.com/soc2/exp-300/soc2-targeted-bundle.tar.gz?X-Amz-Expires=604800. Sending to auditor via PM as well.

Lena (Auditor): Downloaded and verified GPG signature and sha256 sums. Initial pass OK. Two small follow-ups after deeper review: 1) can you include key_policy_sha in kms/rotation.csv for each rotation row? 2) provide a short README with verification steps and the control_map.csv mapping to SOC2 sections.

Priya (sec-eng): Yes to both. We'll add policy_sha column and a README with verification commands: 

# Verify steps (example)
# gpg --verify soc2-targeted-bundle.manifest.sig soc2-targeted-bundle.manifest
# sha256sum -c soc2-targeted-bundle.sha256
# For CloudTrail replay provide event IDs in kms/rotation.csv

Sanjay (eng-security): Noted. We'll normalize all timestamps to UTC and include the event IDs for CloudTrail rows so they can replay GenerateDataKey/Decrypt calls if needed.

Lena (Auditor): Great work team — I'll revert with any additional follow-ups within 48 hours after my deep review. Thanks. :thumbsup:

Priya (sec-eng): Thanks. We'll standby for follow-ups and can produce extended retention exports upon request.

audit-bot: exp-2026-06-01-300 closed at 2026-06-01T15:03:40Z.
